title: Feminine -ā nouns: dual and plural

video.title: आकारान्त स्त्रीलिंग शब्दरूप: बालिका, लता, रमा
video.focus: Now watch the dual (द्विवचन) and plural (बहुवचन) columns, and notice which forms repeat: लते, लताः and लताभ्याम्.

recap: Day 28's quiz answers didn't come. Warm-up: (W1) 2nd case singular of लता? (W2) Say 'O girl!' (W3) Say 'the girl's book'.
idea: Sanskrit has three numbers: singular (एकवचन, one), dual (द्विवचन, exactly two) and plural (बहुवचन, three or more). Hindi has no dual; Sanskrit always uses it for two.
- Address: हे लते, हे लते, हे लताः

**Shortcuts:** 1st and 2nd dual are both लते; 1st and 2nd plural are both लताः; लताभ्याम् covers 3rd, 4th and 5th dual; लतयोः covers 6th and 7th dual. Every -ā feminine noun (बालिका, माला, छात्रा) follows this same pattern.
- The pronoun सा becomes **ते** for two and **ताः** for many: ते बालिके, ताः बालिकाः.
- The verb follows the number: पठति (one), **पठतः** (two), **पठन्ति** (many).
- Two subjects joined by च take a dual verb: रामः सीता च गच्छतः.

Careful: ते is also the masculine plural (ते बालकाः). The noun tells you which is meant. In fully joined texts ताः बालिकाः is written ता बालिकाः (sound-joining); for now we write the words separately.
If the video calls the address form हे लता, the correct singular is हे लते.

examples.meaning: The (female) students see the garlands. (2nd plural)
The boys play with the girls. (3rd plural)
The flowers of the creepers are beautiful. (6th plural)
Rāma and Sītā go to the forest. (dual verb)

quiz.q: What is the 1st case plural of बालिका ('girls')?
quiz.why: 1st plural of -ā feminine nouns ends in -आः: बालिकाः. बालिके is dual, बालिकाभिः is 3rd plural.
Two subjects take the dual verb पठतः. पठति is for one, पठन्ति for three or more.

quiz.q: Which case and number is लतासु?
quiz.why: -आसु is the 7th case plural: लतासु = on/among the creepers. 3rd plural is लताभिः, 6th plural is लतानाम्.

quiz.q: Fill in 'with the girls': बालकाः ___ सह क्रीडन्ति।
quiz.why: सह takes the 3rd case; 3rd plural of बालिका is बालिकाभिः.
Subject छात्राः (1st plural), object कथाः (2nd plural, same form), verb पठन्ति (plural).
